description: Gate A-D edge search ledger for BTCUSD, following the same workflow as JPN/US500/XAUUSD/NASDAQ/DAX/HK/GBPJPY/USDMXN/USOIL. BTCUSD is a reference-template asset (like XAUUSD): per explicit user instruction, killed edges' source folders are NEVER deleted from disk regardless of gate outcome -- only config/edge_universe.json registry entries are removed.

gate_a_2026-09-18.cost_bps_source: BTCUSD empirical p95-p99 bid/ask spread band, pooled/tick-volume-weighted midpoint per config/us500_edge_search_ledger.json per_asset_empirical_spread_bps_2026-09-14 method_caveat note (BTCUSD's two computation methods diverged significantly; pooled method used).
gate_a_2026-09-18.note: 9 of 21 tested edges passed Gate A: trend_long, rangestructure_long, volatilityregime_long, rangestructure_short, volatilitycarry_short, breakdownretestfailure_short, signentropycollapse_short, drawdownhazardcontinuation_short, trendpullbackcontinuation_short.

gate_b_2026-09-18.rule: Rank Gate A survivors' finalists by net_R_per_mean_hold_bar at cost_bps=46.90. Top-3 finalists per edge carried to Gate C. Not a kill gate.

gate_c_2026-09-18.rule: Exact bid/ask tick replay on Gate B's top-3 finalists + control geometry. Filter to executable_r (meanR) STRICTLY > 0. Winner = argmax(R/occupied_day) among positive finalists. KILL if none positive. Applied to all 9 Gate A survivors.
gate_c_2026-09-18.note: 0 of 9 Gate A survivors passed Gate C -- zero deployable edges for BTCUSD, same outcome as USDMXN and USOIL. BTCUSD's extreme cost_bps (46.90, roughly 5-16x the other assets' spread costs) overwhelmed every candidate's gross edge at exact bid/ask execution.
